audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows needed the inverse of the mirror's corrected chart: levels 3 and 4-5 read Skill and levels 6, first item and 2+ items all read Dr. Mundo.
audit.why: The mirror set the chart to K'Sante everywhere except a single Level 3 window for Mundo, ratings 3/4/6/4/4/4/5 from his side. The packet agrees, and a 53.88% win rate does not describe a lane K'Sante loses from 6 onward.
audit.corrected: Level 3 to Dr. Mundo at 4/10; levels 4-5, 6 and first item to K'Sante at 6/10; 2+ items to K'Sante at 5/10 — both layers, with four phase whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and item spikes were described as coin-flips with no cooldowns.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s and heals a percent of missing health; Heart Zapper is 17s and heals off damage he stored. Those two numbers, plus Grievous Wounds timing, decide every extended trade.
audit.corrected: 120s and 17s written into phases[4].why, whys[4], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate mechanical errors. (1) All Out was credited with 'penetration' in five places — Riot's text gives increased damage, healing and transformed abilities, no penetration at all. (2) Infected Bonesaw was said to heal him on landing; it does not, the healing is Heart Zapper, his regen and R. (3) 'Q3 knock-up' again, and the page never mentioned Goes Where He Pleases.
audit.why: His passive resists the FIRST immobilizing effect that hits him, so your Path Maker stun is simply eaten if you lead with it. Spending the two-stack Ntofo pull first strips it and makes the stun land — the single most useful sequencing rule in this matchup, and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Penetration replaced with All Out's real bonus damage and healing in whys[4], whys[6], spikes[3], wants.you[2] and phases whys; the cleaver restated as current-health damage with Heart Zapper as the heal in whys[1], whys[2] and spikes[1]; the passive-immobilize rule and the two-stack pull written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0] and tradeGood.

notes: Packet flagged "All Out's" as a probable wrong name — FALSE POSITIVE, it is K'Sante's own R form. The genuine invention was 'penetration': All Out grants increased damage, healing and transformed abilities in Riot's text, nothing about armour or magic penetration, and five fields told the player to buy into a stat that does not exist. Also added the passive rule the page never had: Goes Where He Pleases resists the FIRST immobilize, so lead with the two-stack pull and land the Path Maker stun second.
